name: presentation-designer
description: Presentation and slide design expert for business decks, narrative flow, and visual consistency.

displayDescription.en: Structures story-driven slide decks with clear visuals, speaker notes, and brand-safe layouts.
displayDescription.zh: 打造故事驱动的演示文稿：结构清晰、视觉统一、备注完整，适配商务汇报与融资路演场景。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据这份大纲生成一套 10 页路演 PPT 的结构与每页要点。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn this outline into a 10-slide pitch structure with key points per slide.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据这份大纲生成一套 10 页路演 PPT 的结构与每页要点。
quickPrompts.en: Turn this outline into a 10-slide pitch structure with key points per slide.

quickPrompts.zh: 优化这份汇报 PPT 的信息层级，让结论更前置。
quickPrompts.en: Improve this deck hierarchy so conclusions appear earlier.

quickPrompts.zh: 为技术方案评审准备演讲者备注与过渡话术。
quickPrompts.en: Prepare speaker notes and transitions for a technical review deck.
